name: 号儿鱼
evolution: 号儿鱼 → 圆号鱼 Lv.36
description: 拥有中空结构的尾巴，空气和水流过的时候会发出小号一样响亮的声音。非常喜欢社交的生物，经常举办盛大的音乐会，不同的小号精灵会轮流展示自己的音乐才华，创造出令人惊叹的合奏。
descriptionEn: Its hollow-structured tail produces a loud trumpet-like sound when air and water flow through it. A very social creature, it often holds grand concerts where different trumpet spirits take turns showing their musical talent, creating astonishing ensembles.
